mapper.insert: INSERT INTO real_estate_sales (building_name, deal_amount, deal_type, property_type, exclusive_area, floor_no, build_year, deal_ym, lawd_cd, jibun, geom) VALUES (#{buildingName}, #{dealAmount}, 'SALE', 'APT', #{exclusiveArea}, #{floorNo}, #{buildYear}, #{dealYm}, #{lawdCd}, #{jibun}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326))
INSERT INTO poi (category, name, geom) VALUES (#{category}, #{name}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326))
mapper.select: SELECT LEFT(lawd_cd, 5) AS lawd_cd, AVG(ST_X(geom)) AS center_lon, AVG(ST_Y(geom)) AS center_lat, count(*) AS deal_count, ROUND(AVG(deal_amount))::bigint AS avg_amount, MAX(deal_amount) AS max_amount FROM real_estate_sales WHERE deal_type = 'SALE' AND deal_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY LEFT(lawd_cd, 5)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO region_summary (region_cd, region_name, geom, center_lon, center_lat, deal_count, avg_amount, max_amount) VALUES (#{regionCd}, #{regionName}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4326), #{centerLon}, #{centerLat}, #{dealCount}, #{avgAmount}, #{maxAmount})
